# Vendored libraries

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `three.min.js` | Three.js | r128 (UMD build, defines `THREE`) | MIT, © 2010–2021 Three.js Authors (header kept in the file) | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js |

Served locally so the game works without a CDN. Single-file builds
(`tools/build-artifact.mjs`) load the same file from cdnjs instead.
